# M11 follow-up register and additional-source decision

The nine required sources have been assessed in order. The provider-timeout
and GWAS mechanisms are [released](m11-release-verification.json). Robin's
owner-authorized outcome refinement is [released](robin/m11-ui-release-verification.json),
but its campaign-owned live observation remains open. Novelty search and a
replacement for the retired free route remain open. `PLAN.md` owns completion.

| ID | Unresolved gap | Existing evidence and local boundary | Next acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| M11-NOV-01 | Does result-conditioned per-draft search find known prior art without falsely rejecting distinct ideas? | [Sakana dossier](sakana-ai-scientist.md); the two frozen current-path screens did not yield an eligible confirmatory triplet. A six-pair exploratory [pilot protocol](sakana/novelty-result-conditioned-pilot-prereg-v1.json) is prepared but explicitly unauthorized until a model is pinned. | Qualify a free model, finish the offline runner and commit a complete pilot preregistration before its first candidate call, then run the bounded paired pilot; adoption still needs an independent three-pair confirmation. |
| M11-NOV-RUNG-01 | Does retaining precise-rung PubMed IDs improve known-prior-art recall without degrading distinct controls or provenance? | [Sakana's sort-pilot trace](sakana-ai-scientist.md) found one exact control hit discarded by a broader rung. The separate [frozen six-pair protocol](sakana/novelty-precise-rung-prereg-v1.json) excludes the observed B. fragilis and SARS examples from primary holdout credit; an isolated candidate has 24 passing targeted tests, but no matched live retrieval has run. | Finish source/process attestation and the offline runner, then authorize only the declared keyless 12-call matched comparison. Decide adoption and release from its frozen primary and non-regression gates; keep an interrupted comparison open. |
| M11-LLM-02 | **Released.** A provider may accept a call whose response is lost, then a retry may send it again. | [OpenScience dossier](synthetic-sciences-openscience.md); native-timeout and durable owner recovery were reproduced and corrected offline. | [Release evidence](m11-release-verification.json): full local suite, deployed commit and healthy production smoke. Live ambiguous provider execution was deliberately not induced. |
| M11-GWAS-07 | **Released.** Variant-level curated association lookup was absent from the tool set. | [ToolUniverse dossier](mims-harvard-tooluniverse.md); official v2 and maintained tool both returned `rs334`. | [Release evidence](m11-release-verification.json): bounded registered MCP tool returned a study association inside deployed image; no model call. |
| M11-ROBIN-01 | An owned empirical result can target a durable hypothesis follow-up, but no campaign-owned completed public run has yet exercised the deployed action. | [Robin dossier](future-house-robin.md), [initial release](robin/m11-release-verification.json), [UI and frozen-case release](robin/m11-ui-release-verification.json). The first [public run](robin/m11-public-run-state.json) lost its Nex Pro route before generation and produced no eligible hypothesis. | After a qualified free-route release, observe one explicit owner action and its outcome→parent→child lineage, gates, ownership and refresh on a campaign-owned public run. |
| M11-OPS-02 | Nex Pro disappeared from the official catalog during a campaign-owned run. | The [public run receipt](robin/m11-public-run-state.json) records eight exact-route admission failures and no hypothesis. The [bounded Qwen probe](baseline/model-qualification/qwen-m11-capabilities-2026-09-25.json) stopped on its first upstream 429; the [read-only shortlist](baseline/model-qualification/m11-free-route-shortlist-2026-09-25.json) found no qualified privacy-compatible replacement. | Qualify one current exact-zero route through bounded actual interfaces, then switch the existing defaults, deploy and observe a public flow; do not retry broad panels or use paid/private-data-collecting fallbacks. |

## Additional repository selection

**Selected: zero.** Each unresolved mechanism has a pinned required-source
comparison and an exact local or official-service boundary to test. No proposed
additional repository supplies a distinct missing mechanism or a provider-backed
replay guarantee that these investigations require. Another general Co-Scientist
clone would duplicate the nine required implementation comparisons; another
broad tool catalog would not establish the GWAS service's live behavior or terms.
Those categories are excluded for this campaign, not assessed as defective
software. If a concrete gap appears during the remaining acceptance work, record
its evidence in `PLAN.md` before reconsidering this decision; the three-source
ceiling and the existing turn limit remain.
